name: April's VR Lab
summary:
This experience has been developed in the context of the XR for Value Creation in Businesses course delivered through ETH Zurich, ETH Heilbronn, TUM and TUM Campus Heilbronn, first taught in fall 2026. This experience has been funded by the ETH Campus Heilbronn / Dieter Schwarz Stiftung.

# Using the app

1. Sit down and ensure you have sufficient space around you to move your hands freely before putting on the headset and picking up the controllers.
2. Open the April's VR Lab app in the App Library.
